model: Same real two-CR-element spatial right-angle cantilever, T=2.5s; production Node/CR and integrator through IAnalysisModel adapter, not full AnalysisStep/Factory
reference_scale_rule: Original frozen per-node/component amplitude with floor1e-4; SO(3) relative angle for rotation

fixed.stability_diagnostic: Below classical linear undamped RK4 imaginary-axis limit2sqrt(2); evolving nonlinear stability and accuracy still assessed by actual output

order_qualification: General noncommuting CR auxiliary Gauss histories are advanced with a second-order accepted-step update. RK nodal tableau alone is fourth-order; the complete augmented model is not certified as uniformly fourth-order. Report observed fixed-step orders, require error reduction and original finest accuracy, and use actual p=2 auxiliary-aware adaptive control. Coaxial planar and no-auxiliary cases separately test fourth-order behavior.
balance_qualification: Adaptive auxiliary history contains two committed half steps, so do not reconstruct accepted Gauss states from macro-endpoint nodal increments. Full-state comparison uses the original independent continuous reference. No Newton or precision-limited statistics apply to explicit RK4.
